Make your library look the way you like, play your albums your way, and see what you're listening to. Plus a few surprises.

## New

- **Your own covers.** Pick any picture as the cover of a song, album, artist or playlist with **Change cover** in its menu. For an album, choose whether the cover goes on every song or only on songs that have none. **Use original cover** brings the old one back.
- **Play and Shuffle buttons** on albums, playlists, Favourites and an artist's songs. A tap plays that collection once and stops at the end.
- **More ways to play albums.** Long press Play or Shuffle on an album and choose **Just this album**, **All albums** to keep going through your albums, or **All albums, repeat** to start over at the end.
- **Know what you're hearing.** The player shows the song's format, bit depth, sample rate and bitrate under the artist, like `FLAC · 24-bit · 96 kHz · 2428 kbps`. The format is read from the file itself, so an AAC file named `.mp3` shows up as AAC.
- **A few surprises.** Some songs the developer loves come with a little something extra. Play them and see.

## Improved

- **New covers show up right away**, even for the song that is playing: in the player, the mini player and the notification.
- **Help has new answers** about your own covers, playing all your albums and the numbers in the player.

## Good to know

- **ForYou Music rereads your songs once** after this update to pick up their audio info, so the first scan takes a little longer on a big library. Your favourites, playlists, notes and play history are kept.
- **Your music files are never changed.** ForYou Music keeps its own copy of the pictures you choose, up to 20 MB each.
- **The numbers describe the file**, not what reaches your headphones. Bit depth is shown for FLAC files only.
- **Did the screen change while a song was playing?** That's one of the surprises. It ends when the song does; double tap anywhere to stop it sooner.
